sections.text: I'll Give Everything for Master Shadow

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Physical Penalty for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 40.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 40.
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
